headline: Public hearings on appeals for a short-term rental at 32 Intervale Avenue and a trail connection at 1093 North Avenue.
summary: Two appeals are on the agenda. One contests an adverse finding on a short-term rental, and the other contests an administrative approval for a trail connection.
items: Appeal of adverse finding of ZP-26-487 for short-term rental at 32 Intervale Avenue (ZAP-26-17)
Appeal of administrative approval of ZP-26-486 for trail connection at 1093 North Avenue (ZAP-26-16)
location: 645 Pine Street, Front Conference Room or Remote on Zoom
